stories.what_happened: A research stellarator held a stable plasma for a record 40 minutes.

sources.title: Test stellarator holds plasma for a record 40 minutes
facts: A research stellarator held a stable plasma for 40 minutes, four times its previous best, the lab said.
Engineers credit a new tungsten wall coating that sheds less material into the plasma.
Two outside physicists called it a real but incremental step.
Net energy gain remains years away, according to the article.

stories.what_happened: An international seabed body scheduled a vote on a 10-year deep-sea mining moratorium.

sources.title: Seabed authority schedules a vote on a mining moratorium
facts: The council of an international seabed body agreed on Monday to vote on a 10-year moratorium on commercial deep-sea mining at its November session.
Twelve member states back the pause.
Two companies holding exploration contracts said a moratorium would breach existing agreements.

sources.title: Council agenda lists the moratorium for 12 November
facts: The published agenda puts the moratorium vote on 12 November.

persona_notes.said: Honestly the companies are going to mine the ocean floor no matter what some council votes on.

stories.what_happened: A national chess federation will trial a shorter time control at youth events.

sources.title: Chess federation tests a shorter time control for youth events
facts: A national chess federation will trial 45-minute games with a 10-second increment at three youth events this winter.
The federation cited shorter attention spans and travel costs.
